MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE

What the trace means

Measured simulation state

Engine rpm, gear, clutch position and throttle come directly from the fixed-step drivetrain state at 120 Hz.

Derived from roller state

Wheel torque and wheel power are calculated from the modelled engine torque, selected ratio, final drive and simulated roller angular velocity.

Estimated crank output

Crank horsepower divides roller-derived wheel power by the vehicle's calibrated drivetrain efficiency. It is always labelled as an estimate.
